name: Lomita City Council Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE LOM]TA CITY COUNCIL
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 10, 2021

  NOTE THAT PURSUANTTO STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDER N.29-20 ISSUED
  ON MARCH 17,2O2O, COUNCIL MEMBERS AND MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WERE ABLE
  TO PARTICIPATE VIA TELECONFERENCE. ACCESS TO THE MEETING WAS MADE
  AVAILABLE VIA ZOOM.

,|
  OPENING CEREMONIES

  a) Call Meeting to Order
  The special meeting of the Lomita City Council was called to order by Mayor Waronek at
  5:01 p.m. on Tuesday, August 10, 2021.

  b) Council Member Waite led the flag salute.
  c) Roll Call
  PRESENT: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and
  Mayor Waronek (all participated via Zoom)

  ABSENT: None

  STAFF PRESENT: City Manager Smoot, City Attorney Rusin, Assislant City Manager Sugano
  and City Clerk Gregory (all participated via Zoom)

2. PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Mayor Waronek announced the time for public comments. There being no requests to
  speak, Mayor Waronek closed public comments.

  SCHEDULED ITEMS

3. CONDUCT COMMISSION INTERVIEWS AND CONSIDER APPOINTMENTS TO FILL
  VACANT SEATS ON THE PUBLIC SAFETY TRAFFIC COMMISSION AND PARKS AND
  RECREATION COMMISSTON

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) lnterview candidates to fill one vacant seat on the Public
  Safety Traffic Commission with a term ending June 2023, and one vacant seat on the Parks
  and Recreation Commission with a term ending June 2025', and 2) Discuss and Consider
  appointing a candidate to fill each vacant seat.

  The City Council conducted interviews of six candidates who submitted Commission
  applications:

  o Michael Baribeau
  . Joe Mccrath
  Page 1 of 3
   .  Marco Gerace
  .  Jay Mattingly
  .  Lindsey Colbert
  .  Stephen Zimmerman

  Applicant Tommy Bonham elected to not be re-interviewed, as he was interviewed during the
  March '1, 2021, special City Council meeting.

  Mayor Waronek stated that he would ask each Council Member who they wish to nominate
  for the position of Parks and Recreation Commissioner and the person receiving three votes
  would be appointed to the Commission. Council Members Waite and Uphoff, and Mayor Pro
  Tem Segawa, all nominated Lindsey Colbert.

  Council Member Waite made a motion, seconded by Council Member Uphoff to appoint
  Lindsey Colbert to the Parks and Recreation Commission.

  MOTION CARRIED by the following vote:

  AYES: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor
  Waronek
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: None

  Mayor Waronek stated that he would ask each member who they wish to nominate for the
  position of Public Safety and Traffic Commissioner and the person receiving lhree votes would
  be appointed to the Commission. Council Member Gazeley nominated Michael Baribeau,
  Mayor Pro Tem Segawa nominated Joe McGrath, Council Member Uphoff nominated Michael
  Baribeau, Council Member Waite nominated Joe McGrath, and Mayor Waronek nominated
  Jay Mattingly. As no applicant received three nominations, the nomination process began
  anew.

  Mayor Waronek nominated Jay Maftingly, Council Member Waite nominated Jay Mattingly,
  Council Member Uphoff nominated Michael Baribeau, and Mayor Pro Tem Segawa
  nominated Jay Mattingly.

  Mayor Waronek made a motion, seconded by Council Member Waite to appoint Jay Mattingly
  to the Parks and Recreation Commission.

  MOTION CARRIED by the following vote:

  AYES: Council Members: Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor Waronek
  NOES: Uphoff
  ABSENT: Gazeley (he had left the Zoom meeting)

4. ADJOURNMENT
  There being no furlher business to discuss, Mayor Waronek adjoumed the meeting at
  6:24 p.m.
